body:
**Scope cull, revision 7 (the person, 2026-10-04).** The person asked to verify live with Claude Code only, call the rest good, and cull macOS ("I'll test it when I get time outside of this epic"). I saved revision 7 and the run adopted it while paused, with no open attempts. All 18 accepted tickets kept their acceptance.

What changed:
- **Sprint 1 goal and exit criteria:** e1 and e5 now say Windows with Claude Code; Codex and Cursor are covered by unit tests.
- **DM-61:** Windows and Claude Code only, with one sign-out/sign-in cycle that covers both the Signed out card and the run pause.
- **DM-104:** c9 and c10 now check the Codex and Cursor replay tests, not live chats. c3 now stops at the Download confirmation and a decline, because a live install would change the person's machine. c16 is limited to Claude on Windows. The orphaned Fireguard criterion c17 is fixed: the node runs Fireguard itself.
- **Sprint 2:** e3 is Windows only. In DM-90, c11 is Windows only and the orphaned Fireguard criterion c12 is fixed the same way.
- **Epic success criterion s2:** Windows only.

The person plans a follow-up epic for any fixes the culled checks turn up.
